title: smooth
body:
## smooth

Applies Laplacian smoothing to a polygonal surface: each iteration moves every point a small step towards the average of its connected neighbours. The output is polygonal data with the same points and connectivity at smoother positions, and arrays are passed unchanged. Use it to reduce faceting or noise on scanned, marching-cubes or STL surfaces before rendering or curvature. Input must be vtkPolyData; run surface first on volume meshes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Laplacian smoothing shrinks surfaces and rounds sharp features; compare volumes or key dimensions with the input before measuring the result.
- VTK's relaxation factor (0.01) is not exposed, so 20 iterations move points only slightly; raise iterations for stronger smoothing.
- Feature edges are not protected and open boundaries are smoothed too (VTK defaults: feature-edge smoothing off, boundary smoothing on); neither smooth nor pvSmooth exposes these switches.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, on a sphere with the default options; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `Smooth`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iterations` | This property sets the maximum number of smoothing iterations to perform. More iterations produce better smoothing. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0}` | `20` | `20` |
| `convergence` | The value of this property limits the maximum motion of any point. It is expressed as a fraction of the length of the diagonal of the bounding box of the input dataset. If the maximum point motion during a smoothing iteration is less than the value of this property, the smoothing operation terminates. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0` | `0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "smooth",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
